provenance: Official public Scryfall card lookup for token-role tests; named cards are test cases, not a generation seed list.

cards.name: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar
cards.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Adeline's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
Whenever you attack, for each opponent, create a 1/1 white Human creature token that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control.

cards.name: Avenger of Zendikar
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token for each land you control.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may put a +1/+1 counter on each Plant creature you control.

cards.name: Secure the Wastes
cards.oracle_text: Create X 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens.
cards.flavor_text:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

cards.name: Raise the Alarm
cards.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
cards.flavor_text: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

cards.name: Felidar Retreat
cards.oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, choose one —
• Create a 2/2 white Cat Beast creature token.
• Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Fires of Yavimaya
cards.oracle_text:
Creatures you control have haste.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Beastmaster Ascension
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control attacks, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment.
As long as this enchantment has seven or more quest counters on it, creatures you control get +5/+5.

cards.name: Mondrak, Glory Dominus
cards.oracle_text:
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
{1}{W/P}{W/P}, Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures: Put an indestructible counter on Mondrak. ({W/P} can be paid with either {W} or 2 life.)

cards.name: Queen Allenal of Ruadach
cards.oracle_text:
Queen Allenal of Ruadach's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus a 1/1 white Soldier creature token are created instead.

cards.name: Scute Swarm
cards.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. If you control six or more lands, create a token that's a copy of this creature instead.
cards.flavor_text:
"Survival rule 782: There are *always* more scute bugs."
—Zurdi, goblin shortcutter

cards.name: Rhythm of the Wild
cards.oracle_text:
Creature spells you control can't be countered.
Nontoken creatures you control have riot. (They enter with your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.)
cards.flavor_text: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

cards.name: Angelic Ascension
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature or planeswalker. Its controller creates a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.
cards.flavor_text: Within her battalion she was known as the Angel of Arkvale. Until now, that was only a metaphor.

cards.name: Contraband Livestock
cards.oracle_text:
Exile target creature, then roll a d20.
1—9 | Its controller creates a 4/4 green Ox creature token.
10—19 | Its controller creates a 2/2 green Boar creature token.
20 | Its controller creates a 0/1 white Goat creature token.
cards.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

cards.name: Ajani, Adversary of Tyrants
cards.oracle_text:
+1: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
−2: Return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
−7: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of your end step, create three 1/1 white Cat creature tokens with lifelink."

cards.name: Blood Ogre
cards.oracle_text:
Bloodthirst 1 (If an opponent was dealt damage this turn, this creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.)
First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)

cards.name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you attack with one or more non-Gnome creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on Anim Pakal, then create X 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens that are tapped and attacking, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on Anim Pakal.
cards.flavor_text: "If we are to protect this world, we can no longer hide within it!"
